note: Three fixes to v0.084's rolled-view wireframe, found by a same-day code review. Clicking bare body tube no longer selects (or drags) an invisible fin - a rolled fin takes clicks on its outline anywhere and on its interior only outside the body. A rolled fin keeps its display color instead of going grey. And fin outlines draw on top of a loaded motor case rather than under it, so the in-body run of a fin stays visible. No numbers change.
